## Our Investments

Agility holds minority shareholdings in listed and non-listed companies. Agility is one of the
largest shareholders in DSV, the world's largest logistics company. It also has a stake in Reem
Mall, a $1.3 billion mega-mall in Abu Dhabi. Other investments include regional logistics and real
estate leaders, as well as a ventures portfolio of emerging technology businesses.
* [DSV][94]
* [Reem Mall][95]
* [Explore all our investments][96]

## Sustainability

Agility has a deep commitment to sustainability and a proven track record of leadership on
environmental and social issues. Each of our businesses has its own sustainability roadmap, based on
its sector and geographic needs, and the company overall is continuing to invest in sustainable
innovation.

## Our Businesses

Agility's group companies include: the largest aviation services company in the world by number of
countries (Menzies Aviation), a global energy logistics business (Tristar), and Agility's logistics
parks business in Middle East, Africa, and South Asia. Other businesses include a construction and
facilities management company (Alliad), a defense and government services logistics business, a
digital logistics platform (Shipa) and more.
* [Aviation Services: Menzies Aviation][90]
* [Energy Logistics: Tristar][91]
* [Industrial Real Estate: Agility Logistics Parks][92]
* [Explore Our Businesses][93]

## Our Investments

Agility holds minority shareholdings in listed and non-listed companies. Agility is one of the
largest shareholders in DSV, the world's largest logistics company. It also has a stake in Reem
Mall, a $1.3 billion mega-mall in Abu Dhabi. Other investments include regional logistics and real
estate leaders, as well as a ventures portfolio of emerging technology businesses.
* [DSV][94]
* [Reem Mall][95]
* [Explore all our investments][96]

## Sustainability

Agility has a deep commitment to sustainability and a proven track record of leadership on
environmental and social issues. Each of our businesses has its own sustainability roadmap, based on
its sector and geographic needs, and the company overall is continuing to invest in sustainable
innovation.

# Technology-Driven Supply Chain Solutions Built Around Your Business

Today's supply chains require more than disconnected services. Powered by proprietary digital
platforms, AI-enabled intelligence, automation, and the expertise of our people, Ryder helps you
navigate complexity with greater visibility, control, and confidence. From fleet leasing and
maintenance to dedicated transportation, transportation management, freight brokerage, warehouse
management, contract packaging and manufacturing, e-commerce and omnichannel fulfillment, and
last-mile delivery, we deliver connected port-to-door solutions designed to keep your supply chain
moving and your business ahead.

[ Contact a Ryder Expert ][218] [ Explore Ryder Port2Door™ ][219]
[Ryder warehouse associate scanning a package beside automated warehouse robots]
Ryder Port2Door™ Solutions

## Engineered to Overcome Supply Chain Challenges

Get a customized solution with the technology to power it, and the people to operationalize it so
you can maximize the flexibility, efficiency, and sustainability of your supply chain.

## Transportation Management

Simplify freight movements with a provider that combines strategic planning expertise, disciplined
carrier management, financial settlement, and real-time visibility to help you control costs,
improve service, and adapt quickly.

## 120K+

freight under management

cross-border freight movements annually
[Ryder transportation management team monitoring freight in a logistics control center]

## Managed Transportation You Can Rely On

Our Transportation Management solution combines disciplined carrier qualification, operational
oversight, AI-driven monitoring, and one of the largest transportation networks in North America to
help you move freight with greater confidence, reliability, and control.

[Explore Transportation Management ][240]
[Three Ryder logistics professionals reviewing carrier data together]

## Expert Carrier Vetting

Carrier selection matters more than ever. Ryder applies disciplined qualification standards and
ongoing oversight to help you secure reliable capacity from carriers to meet rigorous operational
and safety expectations.

[Learn More][241]

## Ryder Technology Powering Your Supply Chain

AI-enabled digital platforms, automation, and real-time visibility tools power Ryder’s technology
ecosystem—helping you operate smarter, faster, and a more connected supply chain.

# Technology-Driven Supply Chain Solutions Built Around Your Business

Today's supply chains require more than disconnected services. Powered by proprietary digital
platforms, AI-enabled intelligence, automation, and the expertise of our people, Ryder helps you
navigate complexity with greater visibility, control, and confidence. From fleet leasing and
maintenance to dedicated transportation, transportation management, freight brokerage, warehouse
management, contract packaging and manufacturing, e-commerce and omnichannel fulfillment, and
last-mile delivery, we deliver connected port-to-door solutions designed to keep your supply chain
moving and your business ahead.

# We have built and run energy logistics where it is hardest. Now we advise on it.

Where energy capital flows, logistics decides the outcome.

Ras Al Khaimah  ·  Founded 2017  ·  Partner-delivered

The problem

## Logistics is where the business case is *won or lost*.

Bases, vessels, port windows, customs, the lead times nobody put in the model. On a frontier
development they set the CAPEX envelope, they move the FID date and they decide when first oil
flows.

Most of the time they are estimated by advisors who have never run a base or cleared cargo through a
working port. We have run all of it, then costed it. So the figure you build on comes from a real
yard and a real quay.

Costed on builds we have run, not modelled from a desk
[Offshore supply vessel working cargo alongside a platform]Offshore logistics, supply run

## From the business case to the base on the ground.

Senior operators on every line, advisory through execution. Each one carries a number a client
tracks. The fifth, Currents, is the intelligence the other four run on.

[
01

### Project supply chain and logistics

Freight, customs, heavy lift, in-country transport and warehousing, run from a single control tower.
We re-engineer the network when the network is the cost.

Proof
ADNOC, 40-plus warehouses across 11 companies into a hub network.
Read the case →

02

### Marine brokerage and advisory

Chartering, fleet strategy and asset valuation, on tier-one shipbroking experience. Brokerage
through our network across the basins we cover.

Proof
ADNOC L&S marine strategy and asset valuation.
Read the case →
][13] [
03

### Shore base and operational mobilisation

Base design and readiness to IOC standard, with our own people embedded to deliver, not only to
advise.

Proof
Versailles in six months. Baleine in two.
Read the case →
][14] [
04

### Independent operational and technical diligence

The unconflicted read on a plan, a port or an operating model, with no stake in the build. Local
content sits here: which regime applies, which suppliers qualify.

Proof
Walvis Bay and Luderitz diligence. DP World shore base study.
Read the case →
][15]

05

### 3PL Currents, the intelligence behind all of it

Six basins, 50 deepwater projects and 140-plus vessels on one screen. It reads the gap between what

Explore the hub → ][16]

The problem

## Logistics is where the business case is *won or lost*.

Bases, vessels, port windows, customs, the lead times nobody put in the model. On a frontier
development they set the CAPEX envelope, they move the FID date and they decide when first oil
flows.

Most of the time they are estimated by advisors who have never run a base or cleared cargo through a
working port. We have run all of it, then costed it. So the figure you build on comes from a real
yard and a real quay.

# **Dependable and Quality Air Freight **
# Since 1986

[ROUTES][25] [ABOUT][26] [CAREERS][27]

## Air Cargo Carriers, LLC

Air Cargo Carriers, LLC. has been synonymous with dependability and quality in the air freight
industry since 1986. As the company has grown, so has the number of industries it serves.

[EXPLORE OUR CAREERS][28]

# Keeping The Economy Moving

Today, Air Cargo Carriers continues to provide the greatest customer care-driven service to the air
freight industry as well as many others. By carrying over the core belief structure forged in the
air freight business of providing the customer what they want, on time and at a competitive rate,
Air Cargo is able to provide superior air freight services to our growing list of satisfied
customers.

[air cargo plane]
[air cargo careers]

# The Go-To Experts in all Things Cargo

Although we pride ourselves on our ability to transport goods from point A to point B safely and
swiftly, at Air Cargo Carriers we do much more than carry cargo. Operating the world’s largest
civilian fleet of Shorts Brothers 330 and 360 aircraft, we’ve become the go-to experts.

We not only maintain the largest inventory of Shorts components, but our subsidiaries are also able
to provide services including: avionics, instrument system repairs and calibration to complete PT6A
engine overhauls.

# Our Services

[jim n acc]

### [Scheduled Routes][29]

Air Cargo Carriers operates several highly reliable and successful scheduled routes throughout the
United States.  ACC also has extensive experience operating routes from the US to: Canada, the
Caribbean and Mexico. [Click here to learn more.][30]

### [ On Demand Charter][31]

Air Cargo Carriers offers the same value added on demand services to the air logistics industry as
has been successfully provided to the overnight express industry for over twenty years! [Click here
to learn more.][32]

### [Maintenance][33]

With highly skilled mechanics on staff, our experienced team schedules inspections, avionics
installs, engine and prop changes and full sheet metal shop duties to Air Cargo Carriers Air Fleet
and also provides on call technical support and full maintenance to other Shorts operators
throughout the world. [Click here to learn more.][34]

### [Part Sales][35]

Air Cargo Carriers has maintained the world’s largest civilian fleet of SD3-30 and SD3-60 aircraft
for over two decades.  We also maintain one of the world’s largest inventories of Shorts spares to
support this fleet. [Click here to learn more.][36]

[FAR Part 61 and 135 Training]

### [FAR Part 61 and 135 Training][37]

With over 30 years of experience in the industry, Air Cargo Carriers knows the importance of
training pilots the right way. Invest in your crews and your company. Join the Air Cargo Carriers
Part 61 Training Program. [Click here to learn more.][38]

### Memberships/Affiliations

[air cargo carriers]

industry since 1986. As the company has grown, so has the number of industries it serves.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for
employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, including sexual orientation and gender
identity or expression, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other
characteristic protected by law.

# The Global Network of Neutral Airfreight Wholesalers

[ ][43]

### About Us

The AirCargoGroup is a global association of like-minded airfreight experts and a global association
consisting of over 40 Global Partners and over 20 Associate Members.

Global Partners are 100% neutral, leading wholesalers from around the world. Global Partners are
exclusive to ACG in the sense that they cannot be committed to other networks.

In markets where 100% neutral Wholesalers do not exist, AirCargoGroup has aligned with Associate
Members. Associate Members are forwarding agents who act neutrally on behalf of ACG and its
customers.

AirCargoGroup works with freight forwarders and logistics providers to enable them to enhance their
reach, buying power, and product quality through our network. Our members and partners allow us to
offer local and global freight forwarders end-to-end airfreight solutions. 

We are committed to delivering value-added international airfreight services exclusively to the
worldwide retail freight forwarding, shipping, logistics, and transport-related industry. Through
AirCargoGroup, a forwarder gets access to a global network, IT, and buying power rivalled only by
large multinationals. 

ACG operates as a global platform and service tool for retail freight forwarders worldwide. They
have access to special airfreight consolidation rates, blocked space agreements, and specialised
neutral air transport handling through our network.

AirCargoGroup was established in 2008 by our founding members Shipco Airfreight and SACO Air.

## Consolidating
## The Air Cargo

### What is wholesale airfreight?

The fundamental purpose of an international airfreight wholesale business is to provide a
value-added international airfreight service exclusively to freight forwarders. Airfreight
wholesaling is the process by which freight agents can purchase space through the intermediary
wholesaler for lower rates than offered by the carrier.

In airfreight, this is achieved either by the wholesaler consolidating many small shipments into a
single booking while taking advantage of the lower rate per kilogram offered by airlines for larger
shipments and then sharing the cost-saving with customers. It is also achieved by combining dense
cargo and volume cargo on the same airline pallet to maximise the chargeable capacity of the pallet
without exceeding its physical weight limit.

Shipco Airfreight. He has over 30 years’ of airfreight experience in operational, commercial, and
managerial functions. Kim is the COO of Global Airfreight at Shipco Transport and founding member of
the ACG. Traits that really matter to him are integrity and honesty.

##### Christian Koeppel

Christian was born, raised, and trained in Germany. He has over 35 years of experience in the
freight industry. Christian is the European Director Airfreight at SACO Groupair. He embraces every

integrity are important to him.

Jacob grew up in a small town in the North of South Africa where his father was a cattle farmer. He
started in the logistics industry in 2010 as a data capturer in the airfreight warehouse. Over the

Meet your dependable air freight broker for custom air freight solutions. We offer routine
assistance and utilize high-tech tracking systems to ensure every shipment arrives on schedule.
Choose from next flight out (NFO), overnight, or economy (general freight), depending on your
individual requirements.

HAND CARRY [EF Icon]

### Secure Hand Carry Services

When you have a highly sensitive or critical shipment, our hand carry service provides security and
speed. This service is not typically available for larger freight, but it's ideal for time-sensitive
or high-value items. It's also the perfect solution for rescuing a delayed shipment, ensuring it
gets back on track and into the right hands as quickly as possible.

[ Learn More ][58]
URGENT TRUCKING [Icon of a truck]

### Urgent Trucking

When air delivery isn't the right fit for your shipment, our urgent trucking solutions might be the
answer. We support your urgent ground shipping needs with expedited trucking options. Choose from
sprinter vans, cargo vans, and trucks of all sizes, including tractor-trailers, to get your items
where they need to be—fast.

[ Learn More ][59]

## Request a Free Freight Quote

KEY BENEFITS

## Serving Diverse Industries with Tailored Solutions

Coordinating just-in-time (JIT) manufacturing shipments? Sending speedy replacement components for
critical IT infrastructure? Our experts work across industries—including construction,
manufacturing, oil and gas, farming, energy, renewables, and aerospace—to fine-tune shipping
solutions for your urgent requests.

# Trust us to move your cargo no matter where you need to go.

There’s no better choice than ASF for your global shipments. Our dedicated global team enables us to
offer favorable rates, timely market intelligence and industry trends that help optimize supply
chain performance.

[Book Your Route][35]
INDUSTRIES

### We make shipping logistics easy for any industry.

Individualized care and deep industry knowledge builds the supply chain consistency you can depend
on.

[Ship Your Goods][36]
* ##### Retail
  
  Our retail shipping expertise saves you time and money.
* ##### Furniture & Housewares
  
  From the factory to your door, reliable delivery of any size.
* ##### Industrial
  
  Industrial shipments handled with care and precision.
* ##### Food & Beverage
  
  Reliable shipping for perishable items to ensure freshness.
* ##### Manufacturing
  
  Services that ensure your supply chain runs smoothly.
* ##### Raw Materials
  
  We’ll help you navigate complex global raw material regulations.
SPECIAL CARGO

### Highlighting just some of our specializations.

Trusted, high-performance care.

[

##### Reefer

Keep your temperature-sensitive cargo fresh and in perfect condition.

Learn more
][37]
[

##### Project Cargo

Expert handling ensures your unique shipment arrives safely.

Learn more
][38]
[

##### Other Cargo Types

We’re equipped to handle even the most complex shipping needs.

Learn more
][39]
TECHNOLOGY

# Technology is an essential enabler, but never a replacement for our human-first approach.

100% tracking of all milestones throughout the container journey.

[**Learn more**][40]
TRACK RECORD

# Confident shipping, trusted results.

Large, medium and small businesses alike count on our personalized, human centric service.

#### 100%

Coverage in 195 countries

#### 1m+

TEUs Moved since 2010

#### Top 10

Export NVO from Vietnam

#### 10+

Direct Contracts with Global Carriers

ASF’s commitment to personalized service and its ability to deliver results has made them a trusted
partner of Raymour and Flanigan for over 15 years. **Their knowledge, dependability and customer
focus have allowed us to maintain a steadfast supply chain** which is imperative to our brand.”

### David Mirabito,

Global Director Of Logistics

# You’re not just another box to us.

We hear from our customers that working with other forwarders often feels like an assembly line. Not
at ASF. For us, you’re a person with a name, a friend and valued member of the ASF community.

across various industries, including automotive, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, fashion and beauty,

[ [IMG] ][64]

route surveys and heavy-lift operations to on-site coordination.

[ [IMG] ][68]

carrier network, flexible capacity, and end-to-end visibility keep your supply chain agile and
responsive.

[ [IMG] ][70]

options to meet your cargo needs. Through strategic partnerships and real-time tracking, we deliver
your goods safely, on schedule and cost-effectively.

# DHL Aviation Cargo

Connect your cargo to the world

From pharma to perishables, dangerous goods to luxury cars, or general cargo, your peace of mind is
secured with DHL Aviation Cargo.

## Expert Partners

Our experts enable your success by ensuring the right cargo products and services for you. Special
projects, interline services, aircraft chartering and handling services are other key offerings.

## Global Reach

Utilize DHL's global network of airports - the largest freighter network there is! More than 300
wide, medium and narrow-bodied jets allow us to cater for shipments of all sizes. These include
Boeing 777 Freighters, B767s and A330s.

## Quality and Visibility

Once you've made your booking, our vastly experienced Operations team are here to take the stress
out of shipping. High service quality is paramount, and there's full shipment visibility via track
and trace.

## Sustainability Focus

We pride ourselves on our sustainable approach. Our GoGreen Plus offering helps customers actively
reduce CO2 emissions via Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) - a green alternative to traditional
aircraft fuel.

# DHL Aviation Cargo

Connect your cargo to the world

From pharma to perishables, dangerous goods to luxury cars, or general cargo, your peace of mind is
secured with DHL Aviation Cargo.

## Expert Partners

Our experts enable your success by ensuring the right cargo products and services for you. Special
projects, interline services, aircraft chartering and handling services are other key offerings.

## Global Reach

Utilize DHL's global network of airports - the largest freighter network there is! More than 300
wide, medium and narrow-bodied jets allow us to cater for shipments of all sizes. These include
Boeing 777 Freighters, B767s and A330s.

## Quality and Visibility

Once you've made your booking, our vastly experienced Operations team are here to take the stress
out of shipping. High service quality is paramount, and there's full shipment visibility via track
and trace.

## Sustainability Focus

We pride ourselves on our sustainable approach. Our GoGreen Plus offering helps customers actively
reduce CO2 emissions via Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) - a green alternative to traditional
aircraft fuel.

# Who said air cargo booking couldn’t be done easily?

Even though sea transportation is more affordable than air freight, the latter is the only choice
when you need cargo to be delivered ASAP. But the booking process can be intimidating and
time-consuming. Well, it used to be. With CargoBooking, quote comparison and air cargo bookings will
never be difficult again.

We have developed an advanced solution to help shippers and freight forwarders manage shipments
quotes and bookings more easily and in one place. The CargoBooking platform allows you to request
air cargo quotes from leading carriers, compare spot rates, book the AWB, and track everything until
your goods arrive. It’s one tool for all your shipment needs.

## Why choose CargoBooking for air freight quotes and booking?

If you’re somehow involved in the air freight industry, we’ve got you covered. Be sure to
[register][14] with us to benefit from:
* **All-in-one platform.** Whatever you need to get transported, be it electronics or
  pharmaceuticals, you can now create your air shipping quote in a few clicks. Specify the details
  of your cargo, review flights with pricing options, request SPOT rate and book the option that
  best meets your needs.
* **Extensive coverage.** As air freight costs vary from carrier to carrier, comparing them is
  crucial. As of now, over 80 airlines are connected to our platform, but we’re not going to stop
  there. The more carriers join us, the more substantial savings are ahead for you.
* **Real-time insights.** CargoBooking empowers you to stay aware of market shifts as they occur.
  You get access to live inventory, allowing you to compare air freight rates online to find your
  best deal for the desired destination and cargo type.
* **API integration.** If you’re a freight forwarder who uses your company’s own software and
  databases, our tool will be an excellent addition to them. It’s a breeze to integrate it into
  existing systems for flawless operation, quotes creation and task automation.
* **Easy-to-use platform and app.** Getting the hang of the CargoBooking platform is not rocket
  science. It’s designed to simplify all the processes for you – from quoting to cargo booking and
  tracking. Plus, you can download it as an app for any iOS or Android device.

## A closer glimpse into air cargo quotes

Air Cargo charges can be confusing. You want to know what you’re paying for. To help you better
understand what those quotes include, CargoBooking lists all the surcharges that make up the total
price along with the chargeable cargo weight. Thus, you can compare not only air freight costs per
kg but also:
* fuel and security surcharges
* freight handling fees
* AWB fees
* additional costs

By getting the bigger picture, freight forwarders and shipping companies can make better-informed
decisions. Knowing what’s included in the total price enables you to plan your shipments with the
carrier of your choice more rationally.

Join CargoBooking for instant quotes and bookings on the latest rates offered by globally operating
air carriers. It’s the best solution to facilitate your booking processes!

## reliability. integrity. service. solutions. quality.

C&R Worldwide Logistics is a full-service logistics management agency specializing in **Tradeshow
Logistics and Planning** as well as High-Value product movement. Our goal is to stand out from the
competition by solving challenging tradeshow transportation issues and providing high quality
service. We understand the complex nature of tradeshows, deadlines, and attention to detail required
for each and every show we handle.

With over 45 years of experience combined, we have aligned ourselves with the best specialized
tradeshow logistics transportation providers in the industry. Because of the long-term relationships
we have developed in the industry, our team of providers goes the extra mile for us and our clients.

## SERVICES

The trade show industry is defined by critical timelines and specific shipping requirements. C&R
Worldwide Logistics provides the quality transportation and shipping services that trade show
customers require.

Whether domestic or international, we are ready to handle the planning, implementation, and control
of your tradeshow booth properties from the point of origin to its destination.

C&R Worldwide Logistics is a full-service logistics management agency specializing in **Tradeshow
Logistics and Planning** as well as High-Value product movement. Our goal is to stand out from the
competition by solving challenging tradeshow transportation issues and providing high quality
service. We understand the complex nature of tradeshows, deadlines, and attention to detail required
for each and every show we handle.

With over 45 years of experience combined, we have aligned ourselves with the best specialized
tradeshow logistics transportation providers in the industry. Because of the long-term relationships
we have developed in the industry, our team of providers goes the extra mile for us and our clients.

## SERVICES

The trade show industry is defined by critical timelines and specific shipping requirements. C&R
Worldwide Logistics provides the quality transportation and shipping services that trade show
customers require.

Whether domestic or international, we are ready to handle the planning, implementation, and control
of your tradeshow booth properties from the point of origin to its destination.

# EVOLVING GLOBAL TRADE

Future-ready supply chain solutions across sectors and borders.

[Explore What We Do][101]
WHY DP WORLD?

## ANYTHING. ANYWHERE.

No matter your size or sector, we can help you scale your trade through our global end-to-end
infrastructure. From local entrepreneurs to global enterprises, we connect you to the markets,
resources, and opportunities that matter most. 

MAKE AN IMPACT

## WE MOVE 10% OF GLOBAL TRADE DAILY

DP World plays a vital role in keeping global trade moving by connecting economies, industries and
businesses worldwide. 

A SINGLE PLATFORM FOR TRADE

## ONE PARTNER. EVERY SOLUTION.

Whatever your cargo, whatever your challenge, we have end-to-end solutions across the entire supply
chain. That's the DP World advantage.

 

[
[DP World Bicester Warehouse]

### Contract Logistics

Our Contract Logistics solutions are built for you. Combining industry expertise with sustainable
practices, we optimise operations, reduce costs, and give you the flexibility to grow with
confidence.

Explore

][102]
[
[Stack of cargo containers]

### Freight Forwarding

With 305 logistics offices worldwide, our Freight Forwarding services are built on a powerful
foundation of ports, terminals, and marine infrastructure.

Explore

][103]
[
[Dominicana Economic zone view]

### Economic Zones

Spanning a collective 9,596 hectares, our Economic Zones support your trade worldwide with tax
incentives, efficient multimodal transportation, and strategic trade hubs.

Explore

][104]
[
[EYEP00101 2024 Netherlands Freight Forwarding Truck Curtain Trailer Lisse Tulips]

### Market Access

Reach the fastest-growing and most challenging markets worldwide. Our Market Access services give
you the tools to unlock new paths to consumers and scale your business in new markets.

Explore

][105]
[
[DP World container ship docked at terminal during golden hour, with stacked containers and yellow
cranes along the quay]

### Marine Services

With over 500 vessels in our fleet, we move cargo that keeps the world turning. From raw materials
to vehicles, our Marine Services deliver fast, reliable ocean transport, wherever trade takes you.

Explore

][106]
[
[Entire view of port]

### Ports & Terminals

Connect your supply chain to the world. With a network of over 60 ports and terminals worldwide, we
keep your cargo moving. Our integrated infrastructure connects key trade routes and allows you to
grow at scale. 

Explore

][107]
[Wind turbines across green hills representing DP World's investment in renewable energy]

## BEYOND BUSINESS

Our sustainability, education, and social impact initiatives ensure that global trade leaves a
positive footprint.

[
[Students with books]

### DP World Foundation

Every individual should have the opportunity to lead a healthy and productive life.

][108]
[
[Windmills (1)]

### Our Climate Journey

We’re committed to understanding and reducing our environmental impact until we reach net zero. 

][109]
[
[Education programs and initiatives for community]

### Empowering People

We focus on improving well-being and making a positive social impact.

solutions tailored to your needs, every time.

Ready to move your freight faster and with greater cost effectiveness? Choose ExpeditedFreight.com
today, and contact us for a [freight quote][34].

## Get a Free [Freight Quote][35]

We provide freight transport services by ground and air for businesses in the U.S., Mexico, and
Canada. We tailor our express delivery services to meet your specific needs. Enjoy premium customer
service with a single point of contact for support during the standardized shipping process.
Wherever your business takes you, we’re with you—mile after mile.

[ Book Now ][36]

## Our Expedited Freight Services

We provide a full range of [ground and air shipping options][37] through our freight carriers when
you transport goods with us. This gives you many fast delivery choices when you expedite shipment.
You won't need to ask for multiple quotes.

We identify the optimal prices and paths for your cargo. You can trust ExpeditedFreight.com to
deliver your freight on time, regardless of the shipping method or modes of transport. This promise
starts when you call and continues until your [expedited shipping][38] reaches its destination.

### [Sprinter Vans][39]

Perfect for urgent deliveries, Sprinter vans offer a budget-friendly solution for transporting small
loads quickly and efficiently. Whether for local routes or long-distance hauls, they deliver
reliable expedited freight service, meeting tight deadlines without compromising cost-effectiveness.

### [Box Trucks][40]

Offering a versatile middle ground between Sprinter vans and semi-trailers, box trucks are
well-suited for transporting retail inventory, construction materials, and standard freight.
Available in 10-16 foot models, they provide the perfect balance of capacity and efficiency for
businesses managing moderate-sized loads.

### [Large Straight Trucks][41]

Built to transport bulkier, heavier shipments, large straight trucks offer dependable performance
for palletized industrial freight and climate-controlled goods. These vehicles combine efficiency
and reliability, making them ideal for specialized cargo that demands secure and consistent
transport.

### [53-Ft Dry Vans][42]

Offering seamless door-to-door service across the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, 53-foot dry vans are
ideal for transporting palletized goods, non-perishables, and large shipments weighing up to 44,000
pounds. Supported by a carefully vetted carrier network, these trailers ensure regulatory compliance
and smooth border crossings while maximizing shipping capacity.

### [Same Day Hand Carry][43]

ExpeditedFreight.com’s same-day hand carry service ensures your urgent shipments are picked up,
flown out, and personally delivered to their destination at the exact time you require. Whether it’s
for critical documents, components, or other urgent materials or equipment, we guarantee fast,
reliable service to your final destination.

### [Air Charter][44]

ExpeditedFreight.com’s air charter services specialize in coordinating aircraft charters, emergency
air transport, and international flights for time-sensitive freight deliveries. Whether it’s a
last-minute emergency or a planned urgent delivery, we secure the right aircraft to ensure your
cargo reaches its destination as quickly and efficiently as possible. Whether it's a last-minute
emergency or a planned urgent delivery, [our expedited services][45] ensure we secure the right
aircraft so your cargo reaches its destination as quickly and efficiently as possible.

## Why work with ExpeditedFreight.com?

### A SINGLE POINT OF CONTACT

From start to finish, you'll have a dedicated expediter guiding your shipment—no frustrating call
centers or wasted time due to miscommunication.

### 24/7 Coverage, 365 Days a Year

Our advanced tracking technology keeps you connected with your shipment every step of the way.
Because it's monitored by our expeditors 24/7/365, you’ll always know exactly where your freight is.

### Expert Expediters

We meticulously analyze ground and air traffic patterns, anticipate weather disruptions, and account
for potential flight delays, ensuring that nothing interferes with your deadline.

## The Right Capacity Is Key to Every Urgent Shipment

Your urgent shipment will be the only freight in the Sprinter van, box truck, straight truck, hot
shot truck, 53’ dry van, or full flatbed to minimize damage and ensure the shipment goes direct from
pickup to delivery.

long-distance ground shipping needs. Measuring 8-12’ x 52" x 70", our carefully selected vans have
the capacity to carry loads up to 3,000 pounds.

# AI-powered logistics
# for the real world

Automate your logistics from factory floor to customer door with the world's most advanced
technology platform for global trade. Flexport drives hard cost savings in your international
freight forwarding while partnering with you to build a leaner, faster supply chain.
* [Request a demo][122]

[profile-photo]

#### Hello Sofia!

Where AI-driven decision making meets real-world execution to drive logistics cost savings

### Supply Chain Visibility

Gain visibility and control over your entire global logistics network, no matter if the freight is
shipped with Flexport as the freight forwarder or managed on your direct contracts. We provide
SKU-level track-and-trace milestones for all your purchase orders, syncing the data across all your
key supply chain applications and orchestrating logistics execution all the way from factory floor
to your customer door.

### Freight Forwarding Control Tower

Drive hard cost savings with our machine learning based consolidation and routing engine for air and
ocean shippers. By consolidating your shipments in real-time as they flow out of your suppliers, we
can reduce international freight spend by an average of 10% while making sure your inventory hits
those critical must-arrive by dates.

### Customs Brokerage

Get control in a chaotic customs environment with our powerful combination of technology and
licensed customs brokers. We've saved companies over $900M in tariffs in the last 5 years through
customs entry automation, duty drawback algorithms, and trade advisory programs. Partner with us to
implement our industry leading compliance tech including our Tariff Simulator, Tariff Refund
Calculator, Product Library, and AI Compliance Auditor.

### Omnichannel Fulfillment

Ship anywhere, sell everywhere and grow faster with a single pool of inventory fulfilled from our
network of fulfillment centers. We help high growth brands achieve hard cost savings, faster
delivery, and improved working capital ratios by connecting our global logistics services directly
to our first-party e-commerce fulfillment and wholesale distribution networks.

## Our technology platform drives hard cost savings for the world’s most important companies.

> Flexport has been handling Everlane's freight forwarding and customs brokerage for quite some
> time. Our supply chain and business processes has gotten more complicated and we've needed that
> partnership in order to evolve.

[everlane logo]

Jim Green

Director of Logistics & Fulfillment, Everlane

[Homepage Split IMG-2]

Flexport Ocean Freight

## Digitize freight forwarding for visibility and control

Whether you’re shipping for the first time or moving thousands of TEUs a year, Flexport optimizes
speed and cost with world-class FCL and ocean consolidation services. What sets us apart are our
technology and our people. We digitize and structure your supply chain data, so you can track each
shipment down to the SKU, from PO creation all the way through clearance and delivery – along with
an expert team supporting you every step of the way.

# AI-powered logistics
# for the real world

Automate your logistics from factory floor to customer door with the world's most advanced
technology platform for global trade. Flexport drives hard cost savings in your international
freight forwarding while partnering with you to build a leaner, faster supply chain.
* [Request a demo][122]

[profile-photo]

#### Hello Sofia!

Where AI-driven decision making meets real-world execution to drive logistics cost savings

### Supply Chain Visibility

Gain visibility and control over your entire global logistics network, no matter if the freight is
shipped with Flexport as the freight forwarder or managed on your direct contracts. We provide
SKU-level track-and-trace milestones for all your purchase orders, syncing the data across all your
key supply chain applications and orchestrating logistics execution all the way from factory floor
to your customer door.

### Freight Forwarding Control Tower

Drive hard cost savings with our machine learning based consolidation and routing engine for air and
ocean shippers. By consolidating your shipments in real-time as they flow out of your suppliers, we
can reduce international freight spend by an average of 10% while making sure your inventory hits
those critical must-arrive by dates.

### Customs Brokerage

Get control in a chaotic customs environment with our powerful combination of technology and
licensed customs brokers. We've saved companies over $900M in tariffs in the last 5 years through
customs entry automation, duty drawback algorithms, and trade advisory programs. Partner with us to
implement our industry leading compliance tech including our Tariff Simulator, Tariff Refund
Calculator, Product Library, and AI Compliance Auditor.

### Omnichannel Fulfillment

Ship anywhere, sell everywhere and grow faster with a single pool of inventory fulfilled from our
network of fulfillment centers. We help high growth brands achieve hard cost savings, faster
delivery, and improved working capital ratios by connecting our global logistics services directly
to our first-party e-commerce fulfillment and wholesale distribution networks.

## Our technology platform drives hard cost savings for the world’s most important companies.

> time. Our supply chain and business processes has gotten more complicated and we've needed that
> partnership in order to evolve.

**The Fracht Group now consists of six independent sister holding companies providing general and
specialized global logistics solutions.**

[Learn More][213]

## Our Solutions

Operating from a network of more than 150 offices worldwide, Fracht Group is an NVOCC
(Non-Vessel-Operating Common Carrier) as well as a traditional freight forwarder. We are an industry
leader in providing general and specialized logistics solutions and multimodal freight transport.

[View All Solutions][214]

[Fracht air freight]

### Air Freight

Fracht’s award-winning air cargo division offers a complete line of domestic and international air
cargo services, including full and partial charter services, consolidated airfreight services,
hazardous material, express, and courier options.

[Learn More][215]

[Fracht ocean freight]

### Ocean Freight

Fracht operates as a licensed and bonded NVOCC. We partner with the world’s leading ocean carriers
to offer point-to-point global FCL (Full-Container-Load) and LCL (Less-Than-Container-Load) General
Cargo services, as well as Project Cargo services for customized and specialized seaborne cargo
movement.

[Learn More][216]

[Fracht truck freight]

### Trucking

Fracht’s trucking services include domestic LTL and FTL, oversized cargo, cross-border, hot shot,
and motor rail solutions. Freight cost optimization helps to balance speed against expense, while
cargo tracking, seamless communication, and a single point of contact help ensure satisfaction.

[Learn More][217]

[Fracht rail freight]

### Rail Freight

Fracht offers specialized Project Cargo transport via rail, with a fleet of specialized railcars
operated by a team of rail engineers, coordinators, and expeditors who help customers avoid the
scale and regulatory limitations of truck freight with more than 200 complex rail cargo moves every
year.

[Learn More][218]

[Crane lifting freight onto a vessel]

### Industries

Fracht supports a global customer base working in countless industries. This experience helps us
align to the logistical needs particular to those industries: what they ship, by what modes, and
with what cargo- and delivery-specific considerations.

[Automotive][219]

[Energy and Industrial][220]

[Defense and Government][221]

[Aid and Relief][222]

local communities, the environment, and society as a whole.

[Learn More][224]

# The Digital Infrastructure
# Powering Global Freight

Connecting carriers, forwarders, and shippers of all sizes to streamline global trade workflows —
from procurement and instant booking to real-time market intelligence

[Compare Freight Rates][100] [Start eBooking][101]

##### Trusted by Leading Supply Chain Experts

How GSA Saves Time & Money with Real-Time Data

[Read Story][102]

How United is Transforming Customers’ Online Cargo Experience

[Read Story][103]

How PUMA Future-Proofs Its Freight Procurement.

[Read Story][104]

## Instant Quotes, Smarter Bookings, Full Visibility

#### ENTERPRISE SHIPPERS

### Smarter Procurement.
### Better Rates. Full Visibility.

Automate RFQs and tendering, utilize competitive rate benchmarking, and manage global freight with
real-time data insights.

[See Enterprise in Action][105]
“Real-time market benchmarking & action enabled our team to identify hundreds of cost optimization
opportunities in a single click.”
Peter Stockhammer
Head Global Logistics Procurement
[Read more][106]

#### Freightos Marketplace

### Instant Quotes. Simple Bookings. Reliable Shipping.

Compare ocean freight rates from top providers, book in seconds, and track everything in one place –
no logistics expertise needed.

[Get Free Freight Quotes][107]
The Freightos website is super easy to use. You put in basic information, and all of a sudden, you
have 20 different options about how it’s going to come about 15 seconds after you click a button.
What is unique is that they have a dashboard that tracks all shipments, and is something that any of
us can log in, check in day or night, see exactly where our shipments are..
Mark Predko
Director of Operations
[Read more][108]
[Loading animation...]

#### FREIGHTOS FOR FORWARDERS

### The Modern Forwarder’s Pricing and Sales Stack

The end-to-end cargo platform with rate management, pricing, quoting, booking and sales solutions.

[Get Started][109]
“The value, without a doubt, is how much quicker it is to process these shipments. Instead of
worrying about what didn’t make it into the system, our team can spend time on what matters –
getting shipments out the door faster and with fewer headaches.”
Megan Kelley
VP of Enterprise Applications
[Read More][110]

#### FREIGHTOS FOR CARRIERS

### Scalable Sales and Distribution Online

Distribute your rates instantly to thousands of forwarders and fill capacity in real-time driving
better revenue and profit growth.

[Book Demo][111]
“The cargo industry is just beginning its digital transformation, and Freightos is helping us lead
the way by creating transparency and expanding our market reach.”
Mark Drusch
Chief Cargo Officer
[Read More][112]

## **Real Stories. Recognized Results.**

“The future of logistics is about working smarter, not harder. With Freightos, we’re driving the
shift towards a more integrated and efficient supply chain, where data sharing isn't just an idea
but a reality.”
Jan Weiller
Global Air Freight Program Manager
Consumer demand for this game was multiples higher than we forecasted. This brought the opportunity
to air freight 150K games, but we ran out of time to ship via sea. We would’ve not been able to do
that without Freightos.
Mark Predko
Director of Operations and Product Management
Freightos removes the lag or the ambiguity that gets in the way of booking freight. As soon as I
generate the quotes I get the right speed and the best price for whatever it is I'm trying to
accomplish.
Dan Otto
Director of Operations
We literally had to go bid out and see where the market was. We had to track our own shipments. It
was outrageous. Once we got with Freightos. It was a whole different story.
Nick Finkelstein
Owner
“Our partnership with Freightos expands our reach to new markets, and provides our customers with a
seamless user experience when they search, book, and track their shipments in real time. This
enables us to better serve our customers by responding even more swiftly to their evolving needs.” 
Marvin Tan
Senior Vice President Cargo
Before we had at least four or five different stakeholders involved in the process. Something that
now is done in a day, it was done in maybe a week.
Paolo Galli
VP Group Logistics Operations

## Frequently Asked Questions

What benefits does Freightos offer importers/exporters?
Freightos’ digitized platform gives you access to competitive freight rates, enhanced supply chain
visibility, and automated tools that save time and reduce costs.
How does Freightos simplify freight booking for businesses?
Freightos covers the entire booking process for importers and exporters by providing [instant rate
comparisons][113], easy online booking, and round-the-clock support, helping businesses of all
sizes, including both SMBs and Enterprise teams, [manage logistics effortlessly.][114]
Is Freightos suitable for small businesses?
Yes. Freightos offers scalable solutions, such as [Freightos Marketplace][115], designed to meet the
needs of small and medium-sized companies without requiring any logistics expertise. Many smaller
companies, including e-commerce businesses such as Amazon sellers, rely on Freightos to simplify and
streamline their global freight processes.
How does the Enterprise solution optimize freight procurement?
Our [Enterprise solution][116] automates RFQs, [benchmarks real-time rates][117], and provides
comprehensive [data insights][118] to streamline and optimize your [procurement process][119].
Thousands of global logistics service providers trust our solution for automating pricing, quoting,
and booking. [Freightos Enterprise][120] helps customers connect directly to them, optimizing spend
and improving relationships.
What features are available for freight forwarders and carriers?
Our vendor-agnostic platform powers some of the world’s largest carriers and forwarders. Over 4,000
global freight forwarders, including nearly all of the top 20, rely on our forwarder pricing,
quoting, and booking solutions. At the same time, hundreds of airlines, ocean liners, and trucking
companies leverage our platform for rate distribution and online sales.
Can I integrate Freightos with my existing systems?
Yes, Freightos offers seamless integrations with various systems, such as ERPs (SAP, Oracle, etc.),
TMSs (OTM, GTN, SAP TM, etc.), RTTVs (P44, 4Kites, etc.), and many more, to enhance workflow and
data consistency through API connectivity.
What happened to WebCargo? Is it now Freightos?
Yes! WebCargo is now fully integrated into the Freightos ecosystem. Don’t worry—the industry-leading
air cargo booking, rate management, and digital quoting tools you rely on are all here, now unified
under Freightos for Forwarders to give you even deeper connectivity to airlines, ocean liners, and
shippers.

# The Digital Infrastructure
# Powering Global Freight

Connecting carriers, forwarders, and shippers of all sizes to streamline global trade workflows —
from procurement and instant booking to real-time market intelligence

[Compare Freight Rates][100] [Start eBooking][101]

##### Trusted by Leading Supply Chain Experts

How GSA Saves Time & Money with Real-Time Data

[Read Story][102]

How United is Transforming Customers’ Online Cargo Experience

[Read Story][103]

How PUMA Future-Proofs Its Freight Procurement.

[Read Story][104]

## Instant Quotes, Smarter Bookings, Full Visibility

#### ENTERPRISE SHIPPERS

### Smarter Procurement.
### Better Rates. Full Visibility.

Automate RFQs and tendering, utilize competitive rate benchmarking, and manage global freight with
real-time data insights.

[See Enterprise in Action][105]
“Real-time market benchmarking & action enabled our team to identify hundreds of cost optimization
opportunities in a single click.”
Peter Stockhammer
Head Global Logistics Procurement
[Read more][106]

#### Freightos Marketplace

### Instant Quotes. Simple Bookings. Reliable Shipping.

Compare ocean freight rates from top providers, book in seconds, and track everything in one place –
no logistics expertise needed.

[Get Free Freight Quotes][107]
The Freightos website is super easy to use. You put in basic information, and all of a sudden, you
have 20 different options about how it’s going to come about 15 seconds after you click a button.
What is unique is that they have a dashboard that tracks all shipments, and is something that any of
us can log in, check in day or night, see exactly where our shipments are..
Mark Predko
Director of Operations
[Read more][108]
[Loading animation...]

#### FREIGHTOS FOR FORWARDERS

### The Modern Forwarder’s Pricing and Sales Stack

The end-to-end cargo platform with rate management, pricing, quoting, booking and sales solutions.

[Get Started][109]
“The value, without a doubt, is how much quicker it is to process these shipments. Instead of
worrying about what didn’t make it into the system, our team can spend time on what matters –
getting shipments out the door faster and with fewer headaches.”
Megan Kelley
VP of Enterprise Applications
[Read More][110]

#### FREIGHTOS FOR CARRIERS

### Scalable Sales and Distribution Online

Distribute your rates instantly to thousands of forwarders and fill capacity in real-time driving
better revenue and profit growth.

[Book Demo][111]
“The cargo industry is just beginning its digital transformation, and Freightos is helping us lead
the way by creating transparency and expanding our market reach.”
Mark Drusch
Chief Cargo Officer
[Read More][112]

## **Real Stories. Recognized Results.**

“The future of logistics is about working smarter, not harder. With Freightos, we’re driving the
shift towards a more integrated and efficient supply chain, where data sharing isn't just an idea
but a reality.”
Jan Weiller
Global Air Freight Program Manager
Consumer demand for this game was multiples higher than we forecasted. This brought the opportunity
to air freight 150K games, but we ran out of time to ship via sea. We would’ve not been able to do
that without Freightos.
Mark Predko
Director of Operations and Product Management
Freightos removes the lag or the ambiguity that gets in the way of booking freight. As soon as I
generate the quotes I get the right speed and the best price for whatever it is I'm trying to
accomplish.
Dan Otto
Director of Operations
We literally had to go bid out and see where the market was. We had to track our own shipments. It
was outrageous. Once we got with Freightos. It was a whole different story.
Nick Finkelstein
Owner
“Our partnership with Freightos expands our reach to new markets, and provides our customers with a
seamless user experience when they search, book, and track their shipments in real time. This
enables us to better serve our customers by responding even more swiftly to their evolving needs.” 
Marvin Tan
Senior Vice President Cargo
Before we had at least four or five different stakeholders involved in the process. Something that
now is done in a day, it was done in maybe a week.
Paolo Galli
VP Group Logistics Operations

## Frequently Asked Questions

What benefits does Freightos offer importers/exporters?
Freightos’ digitized platform gives you access to competitive freight rates, enhanced supply chain
visibility, and automated tools that save time and reduce costs.
How does Freightos simplify freight booking for businesses?
Freightos covers the entire booking process for importers and exporters by providing [instant rate
comparisons][113], easy online booking, and round-the-clock support, helping businesses of all
sizes, including both SMBs and Enterprise teams, [manage logistics effortlessly.][114]
Is Freightos suitable for small businesses?
Yes. Freightos offers scalable solutions, such as [Freightos Marketplace][115], designed to meet the
needs of small and medium-sized companies without requiring any logistics expertise. Many smaller
companies, including e-commerce businesses such as Amazon sellers, rely on Freightos to simplify and
streamline their global freight processes.
How does the Enterprise solution optimize freight procurement?
Our [Enterprise solution][116] automates RFQs, [benchmarks real-time rates][117], and provides
comprehensive [data insights][118] to streamline and optimize your [procurement process][119].
Thousands of global logistics service providers trust our solution for automating pricing, quoting,
and booking. [Freightos Enterprise][120] helps customers connect directly to them, optimizing spend
and improving relationships.
What features are available for freight forwarders and carriers?
Our vendor-agnostic platform powers some of the world’s largest carriers and forwarders. Over 4,000
global freight forwarders, including nearly all of the top 20, rely on our forwarder pricing,
quoting, and booking solutions. At the same time, hundreds of airlines, ocean liners, and trucking
companies leverage our platform for rate distribution and online sales.
Can I integrate Freightos with my existing systems?
Yes, Freightos offers seamless integrations with various systems, such as ERPs (SAP, Oracle, etc.),
TMSs (OTM, GTN, SAP TM, etc.), RTTVs (P44, 4Kites, etc.), and many more, to enhance workflow and
data consistency through API connectivity.
What happened to WebCargo? Is it now Freightos?
Yes! WebCargo is now fully integrated into the Freightos ecosystem. Don’t worry—the industry-leading
air cargo booking, rate management, and digital quoting tools you rely on are all here, now unified
under Freightos for Forwarders to give you even deeper connectivity to airlines, ocean liners, and
shippers.

The future of air cargo is distributed,
autonomous, and radically affordable.
Grid is building it.

The future of air cargo is distributed, autonomous,
and radically affordable.
Grid is building it.

## Meet Lifter:
## Thousands of pounds.
## Thousands of miles.
## Uncrewed. Unmatched.

Tactical Waypoint Alpha (TWP-A) : Lat/Long: 13.5841° N / 144.9266° E

[Illustration 1]
[Illustration 2]

## We’re building the
## pickup truck of the skies

Uncrewed, long-range cargo aircraft that move heavy payloads across thousands of miles.

Uniquely low-cost, rugged, and built for strategic reach, our distributed fleet powers resilient
logistics at scale.

## The Grid

Tactical Waypoint Alpha (TWP-A) : Lat/Long: 48.8566° N / 2.3522° E

[ From A to B. One aircraft or a thousand. The Grid scales. The cargo moves ]

The Grid is a scalable network of autonomous aircraft. It delivers strategic reach, operational
flexibility, and resilient logistics at any scale. Each Lifter expands the network’s capability,
adding range, redundancy, and adaptability wherever it's needed.

## Key Pillars

### Simple, rugged

Lifter is purpose-built for cargo, designed from first principles to deliver only what matters: a
rugged airframe with minimal moving parts, a proven powertrain, and a simplified architecture for
rapid assembly and repair. No waste, no frills—just scalable, reliable logistics at a fraction of
the cost.

[Simple, rugged]

### AI enhanced autonomy

Grid’s autonomy stack blends classical controls with modern AI, enabling aircraft to operate
intelligently across long distances and in contested environments. From takeoff to delivery, the
system adapts in real time, learns from other aircraft across the Grid, and minimizes the need for
human oversight.

[AI enhanced autonomy]

### Distributed network operations at scale

Lifter aircraft operate as a resilient, distributed mesh. With seamless fleet-level supervision, a
small ground team can command dozens of aircraft across vast regions.

[Distributed network operations at scale]

reduce electricity bill by turning off unnecessary devices. Here is the list of items with estimate
units of electricity it consumed if used for 24 hours:
* **Fan:** On an average, an 80W fan consumes 4 units of electricity/day.
* **TV** consumes around 3 units a day.

  straight.
* A **refrigerator** consumes around 4-6 units, depending on the size and how old your appliance is.

### Understanding IESCO Bill:

There are numerous parameters in the bill, we have explained some of them below:

#### Connection Date:

It is the date when you initially registered yourself in iesco’s database for electricity
connection.

#### Reference Number:

This is the important part. This reference number is the basic identification of your bill that is
just like your account number. You can pay your bill on behalf of this reference number and get
duplicate copy of your bill by providing this reference number etc.

[iesco bill reference number]

#### Dates:

In the top right corner of your bill, you can find reading date, issue date, and due date. These
dates represent when the agent noted your meter reading, when bill was issued and what is the last
date to pay your bill.

#### FPA:

A lot of people ask what is FPA in the electricity bill? FPA stands for Fuel Price Adjustment. This
is a system to adjust electricity fees based on fuel prices fluctuation. The FPA price belongs to
the fuel pricing of rental power companies that generate electricity from Crude Oil etc.

#### TR Surcharge:

T.R is Tariff Rationalization Surcharge. In revised criteria, NEPRA will determine tariff and
Government notify a uniform tariff for all Distribution Companies. This is the difference of NEPRA
and GOP tariff. If difference is positive, it will be payable by GOP as "Subsidy". However in case
of negative difference, the Distribution Company will pay to GOP as "Inter DISCO Tariff
Rationalization Surcharge ( IDTR SUR )".

#### QTR Tariff Adj / DMC

Quarterly tariff adjustment amount that you may see in your bill after every 3 months. This tax
applies to domestic consumers if they cross the limit of 300 units. For commercial and industrial
consumers, this tax applies even if a single unit is consumed.

#### FC Surcharge:

FC stands for Financing Cost. Financing Cost Surcharge was initially decided to be 43 paisa per
unit, to ensure collection of debt servicing of the Power Holding Private Limited.

#### Bill Timing:

Depending on your region, you may receive your bill on different dates of the month. However you can
see bill history to know about your bill reading date, issue date and due date to get idea about the
bill timing.

## IESCO Structure

To keep the electric supply uninterrupted and maintain customer satisfaction, IESCO is divided into
4 circles, 19 divisions and 104 subdivisions. Superintending Engineers (SEs) are head of Circles
whereas Divisions are supervised by Executive Engineers (XENs). All Subdivisions are managed by Sub
Divisional Officers (SDOs) and also each division has a Customer Services Officer which is called
CSO.

The company takes care of the electricity distribution network in the administrative districts of
Rawalpindi, Chakwal, Attock, Jhelum and Federal Capital Islamabad.

Technically, IESCO consists of 108 Grid Stations having total capacity of 5,224 MVA and distributes
the power through 951 Feeders including AJK.

### How to contact IESCO (Complaints & Helpline)

For complains, you can visit the billing complaint resolution desk at IESCO Head Office located
Street # 40 Sector G-7/4 Islamabad. You can visit that address and submit your complaints. You can
also submit your complaint directly to the IESCO CEO by sending your complaint email to
[ce@iesco.com.pk][24].

Here is IESCO helpline number: [051-9252937][25].

If you are looking for nearest customer services center, you can check this complete list of
[customer services centers][26].

## FAQs

**How to check iesco online bill?**
You can check iesco online bill at iescobill.pk by entering 14 digit reference number.

**How to calculate iesco estimate bill?**
You can calculate iesco electricity cost of your residential connection by entering consumed units
here.

**Can I check bill by meter number?**
IESCO subscribers can only check bill by 14 digit reference number, not by meter number.

**Can I check iesco bill by name or address?**
Sorry, you can not check your bill by name or address but only using reference number. If you have
14 digit reference number, you can see your bill here.

**How to get previous month bill?**
If you did not receive your bill, you can get a duplicate copy of your last month bill here.

**What is unit rate for iesco residential connection?**
You can check iesco's residential units rates here.

**How to change consumer name in iesco electricity bill?**
The procedure to change consumer name on iesco bill is same like applying for new connection. You
can visit the iesco office and apply for the name change request.

**How can I apply for a new connection?**
If you want a new iesco connection, you will have to fill and submit "Application and Agreement"
form which is also known as A&A form.

**Can I check iesco bill by id card (cnic) number?**
Currently you can only check the bill by 14 digit reference number.

For further inquiries related to your bill, you can [contact us][27].

IESCO customers can generate and download their e bill either it is their first bill or a latest

Islamabad Electric Supply Company (IESCO) is a division of [WAPDA][22]. It was started in 1998 to
handle the responsibilities and functions of Islamabad area. IESCO supplies electricity to the
region from Attock to Jhelum. So if you are an IESCO subscriber, and looking for a duplicate online

Using our online duplicate bill service, you can not only view your bill, but also reprint it and

## Tips to reduce the IESCO bill

Lets take a quick overview on how many units your day-to-day appliances consume and how you can
reduce electricity bill by turning off unnecessary devices. Here is the list of items with estimate
units of electricity it consumed if used for 24 hours:
* **Fan:** On an average, an 80W fan consumes 4 units of electricity/day.
* **TV** consumes around 3 units a day.
* A 24W **energy saver** uses 1-2 units a day.
* Heavier appliances like a **one-ton AC** consumes around 18 units if it runs for 24 hours
  straight.
* A **refrigerator** consumes around 4-6 units, depending on the size and how old your appliance is.

being used at a time. Here are some tips to reduce electricity bill amount:
1. Switch off unnecessary appliances.
2. Instead of turning on five energy savers, try to manage with four or even less.
3. Utilize daylight to lighten your rooms instead of electric bulbs where possible.
4. Don’t use ACs during the peak hours.
5. Use your ACs at 26 degrees.
6. Keep your rooms ventilated with fresh air to reduce use of ACs.

### Understanding IESCO Bill:

There are numerous parameters in the bill, we have explained some of them below:

#### Connection Date:

It is the date when you initially registered yourself in iesco’s database for electricity
connection.

#### Reference Number:

This is the important part. This reference number is the basic identification of your bill that is
just like your account number. You can pay your bill on behalf of this reference number and get
duplicate copy of your bill by providing this reference number etc.

[iesco bill reference number]

#### Dates:

In the top right corner of your bill, you can find reading date, issue date, and due date. These
dates represent when the agent noted your meter reading, when bill was issued and what is the last
date to pay your bill.

#### FPA:

A lot of people ask what is FPA in the electricity bill? FPA stands for Fuel Price Adjustment. This
is a system to adjust electricity fees based on fuel prices fluctuation. The FPA price belongs to
the fuel pricing of rental power companies that generate electricity from Crude Oil etc.

#### TR Surcharge:

T.R is Tariff Rationalization Surcharge. In revised criteria, NEPRA will determine tariff and
Government notify a uniform tariff for all Distribution Companies. This is the difference of NEPRA
and GOP tariff. If difference is positive, it will be payable by GOP as "Subsidy". However in case
of negative difference, the Distribution Company will pay to GOP as "Inter DISCO Tariff
Rationalization Surcharge ( IDTR SUR )".

#### QTR Tariff Adj / DMC

Quarterly tariff adjustment amount that you may see in your bill after every 3 months. This tax
applies to domestic consumers if they cross the limit of 300 units. For commercial and industrial
consumers, this tax applies even if a single unit is consumed.

#### FC Surcharge:

FC stands for Financing Cost. Financing Cost Surcharge was initially decided to be 43 paisa per
unit, to ensure collection of debt servicing of the Power Holding Private Limited.

#### Bill Timing:

Depending on your region, you may receive your bill on different dates of the month. However you can
see bill history to know about your bill reading date, issue date and due date to get idea about the
bill timing.

## IESCO Structure

To keep the electric supply uninterrupted and maintain customer satisfaction, IESCO is divided into
4 circles, 19 divisions and 104 subdivisions. Superintending Engineers (SEs) are head of Circles
whereas Divisions are supervised by Executive Engineers (XENs). All Subdivisions are managed by Sub
Divisional Officers (SDOs) and also each division has a Customer Services Officer which is called
CSO.

The company takes care of the electricity distribution network in the administrative districts of
Rawalpindi, Chakwal, Attock, Jhelum and Federal Capital Islamabad.

Technically, IESCO consists of 108 Grid Stations having total capacity of 5,224 MVA and distributes
the power through 951 Feeders including AJK.

**How to check iesco online bill?**
You can check iesco online bill at iescobill.pk by entering 14 digit reference number.

**How to calculate iesco estimate bill?**
You can calculate iesco electricity cost of your residential connection by entering consumed units
here.

**Can I check bill by meter number?**
IESCO subscribers can only check bill by 14 digit reference number, not by meter number.

**Can I check iesco bill by name or address?**
Sorry, you can not check your bill by name or address but only using reference number. If you have
14 digit reference number, you can see your bill here.

**How to get previous month bill?**
If you did not receive your bill, you can get a duplicate copy of your last month bill here.

**What is unit rate for iesco residential connection?**
You can check iesco's residential units rates here.

**How to change consumer name in iesco electricity bill?**
The procedure to change consumer name on iesco bill is same like applying for new connection. You
can visit the iesco office and apply for the name change request.

**How can I apply for a new connection?**
If you want a new iesco connection, you will have to fill and submit "Application and Agreement"
form which is also known as A&A form.

**Can I check iesco bill by id card (cnic) number?**
Currently you can only check the bill by 14 digit reference number.

DSV starts Chicago Rockford-Incheon freighter service

Freight forwarder DSV has launched a scheduled weekly freighter service between Chicago Rockford
International Airport in the US and Incheon International Airport in South Korea. The service will
depart from Chicago Rockford on Saturdays and builds on DSV's services to Shanghai Pudong
International Airport, launched in November 2025, and Luxembourg Airport, launched in June. Air
Cargo News has requested more information from DSV about its capacity arrangements for the service.
For Chicago Rockford, the service further strengthens its position as a strategic cargo gateway
connecting Asia, Europe, and the Americas. DSV also plans to introduce a new scheduled service
connecting Chicago Rockford with Chennai International Airport later this year. "Incheon is one of
Asia's most important cargo hubs, and with this new service, DSV can provide reliable capacity and
connectivity via the network we are building through Rockford," said Mohamed Siraj, vice president
air direct/global gateways, DSV. "The airport has consistently demonstrated the operational
reliability and flexibility needed to support scheduled international freighter services, making it
a natural choice as we continue developing our air cargo operations." Zack Oakley, executive
director, Chicago Rockford, commented: "The launch of our Incheon service marks another important
milestone in our long-term strategy to increase Rockford's connectivity with Asia. "Together with
our Shanghai and Luxembourg services, we offer reliable, scheduled connections linking the United
States with Europe and Asia through a dedicated cargo airport built around speed, efficiency, and
operational reliability."

Source: aircargonews.net

Read more

News in Brief Podcast | Week 30 2026 | Transpac, terminals and air cargo contracts

This week on News in Brief, we unpack the latest wave of US tariffs on Canada and Brazil and what
they mean for global supply chains. Gavin van Marle explains why transpacific shipping is entering
uncharted territory, explores the latest developments in ports and terminal operators - from Santos
to the Panama Canal - and examines how carriers are keeping rates resilient despite ongoing
overcapacity concerns. We also speak to Neutral Air Partner CEO Christos Spyrou about the changing
dynamics of air freight contracts, the growing influence of SME forwarders and the impact of US
tariffs on air cargo. All this and more in less than 25 minutes!

Source: theloadstar.com

Read more

Air freight contracts a challenge for shippers and forwarders in a tightening market

Annual air freight contracts are becoming increasingly difficult to sustain as market conditions
shift decisively in favour of airlines and freight forwarders, according to Xeneta. During a
webinar, Adi Šunj, Xeneta's lead customer success manager, said the tightening market and a growing
reliance on spot purchasing were forcing both forwarders and shippers to rethink how they approached
long-term pricing agreements. "We typically define 80% as the shifting point between a buyer's
market and a seller's market," said Mr Šunj, referring to the company's dynamic load factor metric,
measuring aircraft capacity utilisation. As capacity tightens, airlines gain greater pricing power,

DSV starts Chicago Rockford-Incheon freighter service

Freight forwarder DSV has launched a scheduled weekly freighter service between Chicago Rockford
International Airport in the US and Incheon International Airport in South Korea. The service will
depart from Chicago Rockford on Saturdays and builds on DSV's services to Shanghai Pudong
International Airport, launched in November 2025, and Luxembourg Airport, launched in June. Air
Cargo News has requested more information from DSV about its capacity arrangements for the service.
For Chicago Rockford, the service further strengthens its position as a strategic cargo gateway
connecting Asia, Europe, and the Americas. DSV also plans to introduce a new scheduled service
connecting Chicago Rockford with Chennai International Airport later this year. "Incheon is one of
Asia's most important cargo hubs, and with this new service, DSV can provide reliable capacity and
connectivity via the network we are building through Rockford," said Mohamed Siraj, vice president
air direct/global gateways, DSV. "The airport has consistently demonstrated the operational
reliability and flexibility needed to support scheduled international freighter services, making it
a natural choice as we continue developing our air cargo operations." Zack Oakley, executive
director, Chicago Rockford, commented: "The launch of our Incheon service marks another important
milestone in our long-term strategy to increase Rockford's connectivity with Asia. "Together with
our Shanghai and Luxembourg services, we offer reliable, scheduled connections linking the United
States with Europe and Asia through a dedicated cargo airport built around speed, efficiency, and
operational reliability."

Air freight contracts a challenge for shippers and forwarders in a tightening market

Annual air freight contracts are becoming increasingly difficult to sustain as market conditions
shift decisively in favour of airlines and freight forwarders, according to Xeneta. During a
webinar, Adi Šunj, Xeneta's lead customer success manager, said the tightening market and a growing
reliance on spot purchasing were forcing both forwarders and shippers to rethink how they approached
long-term pricing agreements. "We typically define 80% as the shifting point between a buyer's
market and a seller's market," said Mr Šunj, referring to the company's dynamic load factor metric,
measuring aircraft capacity utilisation. As capacity tightens, airlines gain greater pricing power,
while shippers lose leverage in negotiations, he explained. Companies that negotiated competitive
annual contracts when market conditions were softer may now find those agreements increasingly
difficult to maintain if they sit below prevailing market rates, he added. "Understanding that your
service may change, that you may not get the same service as you had in the past - given the
increase in the delta between your position and the market high - I think is key," he said. This
challenge for shippers is compounded by the growing proportion of cargo moving on the spot market
outside contracts. Mr Šunj said Xeneta's airline spot share data showed when forwarders were relying
more heavily on ad hoc purchases rather than longer-term block space agreements. "We've seen over
time that when the airline spot share rises above 40% to 50%, or more, then it becomes not just
significant pressure for the forwarder to move and buy their cargo, but also to align their
contracts with their customers," he explained. He added that, when 70%-80% of cargo is moving under
spot pricing, forwarders faced increasing uncertainty over future procurement costs, making
fixed-price agreements with customers significantly harder to support. "It creates pressure for both

contract is going to be able to get honoured." Rather than focusing solely on achieving the lowest
possible rate, Xeneta argues, shippers should understand where their pricing sits relative to the

around market conditions also helps explain rising costs to customers during periods of disruption.
"It becomes very difficult a lot of times to manage internally what's happening in the market," said
Mr DeVary. "With data, you can both look at the same information at the same time and ensure the

## Air Freight Made Clear for Modern Global Trade

## Move urgent cargo across borders with speed, clarity, and confidence through expert air freight
## insights and logistics guidance.

[ Explore Air Freight Guides ][11]

# Air Freight Guides, Cargo Insights, and Logistics Resources

[[Koby][Koby]][12]

### [Written by Koby Molvig][13]

Koby Molvig writes for liljononline.com, covering air freight, air cargo, freight forwarding, and
global logistics. He helps readers understand fast international shipping with clear, practical, and
business-focused insights.

Stay informed with detailed educational content covering air freight transportation, cargo handling,
freight forwarding, shipping regulations, customs compliance, aviation logistics, and supply chain
management.

Built for business owners, importers, exporters, logistics professionals, and curious readers
seeking clear explanations of the global air cargo industry.

Air freight is the transportation of cargo by aircraft, offering one of the fastest and most
reliable shipping methods available today. Whether you’re researching freight forwarding, customs
procedures, shipping costs, or industry resources such as [Cargomaster air freight][14], this
knowledge hub provides practical information to help you better understand the world of air cargo
and logistics.

### International Shipping

### Sea Freights

Your ocean FCL and LCL containers are ready to ship. Now, you might be finding available space on a
vessel at a competitive rate. With so many ocean shipping options, it may be challenging. Complete
ocean freight services. Utilizing high productivity carriers in all trade lanes between ports
throughout the world. we can help you assess and select the best ocean freight service to meet your
goals. Our in-house ocean freight from all major ports, then offers weekly sailing schedules in
frequented lanes around the world.

### Air Freights

We provide import and export door-to-door air freight transportation services. Whether price or
speed is the issue, we can arrange for consolidated or direct air service. Our experienced team is
ready to route your goods to or from almost any point in the world. We provide several options to
ship pre-booked space on a direct airline, organized on either door-to-door, door-to-airport, or
airport-to- airport basis.

### Transportation

Manorama Supply Chain Solution is an all-in-one solution to your logistics needs. We provide
end-to-end solutions in the Logistics / Transportation industry across India. We are focused to
bring quality service at a reasonable cost to all our clients. We have trucks, containers, logistic
supports to meet the immediate requirements of the clients within stipulated time frame.We can
easily scale up to your requirements and have our attached fleet of 150+ vehicles.

connected by rail and road
Close to the industrial hub.

experienced customs agents handle your customs process to minimize risks. Easily upload mandatory
documents online and receive regular updates on your clearance status. Easy tracking of customs
status Prevent delays and penalties
