& labelling, shrink rapping, break bulk and repacking, order fulfilment, reverse logistics, stock
segregation / rotation, In & Out, Put away & Pick, Kit Making, In-Plant management etc. The sharing
warehouses facility store goods of several clients. This exploits the benefits which arise from the
increase of scale. Personnel, systems, equipment and space can be deployed flexibly. Furthermore, we
work with dedicated teams to manage your inventory on a daily basis. Thus we guarantee an optimal
service for our customers.

deck, Availability of equipment (up to 47mt), Door-to-door shipment

### Wiggle

][104]

British online store of clothing, footwear and accessories for running, swimming, cycling,
triathlon, hiking. Delivery is usually through [P2P TRAKPAK][105] and [MetaPack][106]. [Track Wiggle
orders][107] with our service.

[

### Victoria's Secret

][108]

One of the most famous companies in the world of lingerie. Orders are sent through the aggregator of
the postal services [eShopWorld][109], which forwards packages [Aramex][110], [Asendia][111],
[Chronopost][112]. [Learn more about Victoria's Secret order tracking][113].

[

### TAM Beauty

][114]

TAM Beauty is a popular cosmetics store with adequate prices and fast delivery, orders are most
often sent through [P2P-TrakPak][115], [more about tracking orders from TAM Beauty][116].

[

### DHGate

][117]

DHGate is a marketplace of independent Chinese wholesalers and drop shippers. When you buy through
DHGate, you are buying from one of these sellers, although DHGate handles the transaction. It's a
lot like when you buy something on eBay, but DHGate offers a refund guarantee on all purchases.
Orders are delivered by [China Post][118], [China Post EMS/ePacket][119].

[

### Wayfair

][120]

Wayfair is one of the world's largest online destinations for the home and sells furniture and
home-goods. Their digital platform offers 14 million items from more than 11,000 global suppliers.
Brans include Joss&Main, AllModern, Birch Lane, Perigold. Deliveries are made mainly with
[UPS][121], [FedEx][122], [Canada Post][123], [Royal Mail][124].

[

### Amazon Logistics (AMZL_US)

][125]

Amazon Logistics is a shipping and delivery service meant to complement existing providers like UPS,
US Post and FedEx. It offers 7-day and same-day delivery options, and it utilizes a host of
third-party logistics partners across the country to make it happen – including walkers, bicyclists
and motorcyclists in some areas. Read more to find out [how to track Amazon Logistics][126].

[

### Walmart

][127]

Walmart Inc. is an American multinational retail corporation that operates a chain of hypermarkets,
discount department stores, and grocery stores from the United States. [How to track Walmart
order][128].

[

### Cult Beauty

][129]

THE destination for the very best in beauty, they trawl the globe to create a curated 'Hall of
Fame'. From bestselling skin care to make up must-haves. Orders are delivered with
[P2P-TrakPak][130], read on and find out [more about tracking orders from Cult Beauty][131].

[

### Apple.com

][132]

Track Apple.com orders, shipments, returns and repairs, read on and find out [more about tracking
orders from Apple.com][133].

[

### eGlobal Central

][134]

eGlobal Central offers great discount plus free shipping on latest gadgets: DSLR, lens, mobile,
camera, tablet, audio. Orders are shipped with Central Post courier and delivered by
[wnDirect][135], [DPD][136], [Yodel][137], [DHL Paket][138], read on and find out how to [track
orders from eGlobal Central][139].

[

### Banggood

][140]

Banggood is a relatively young online store, but it is rapidly gaining popularity, orders are sent
mainly through [PostNL][141], [Flyt Express][142], and others. There is a support forum where they
quickly answer questions about package tracking, [more about tracking Banggood orders][143].

[

### Yodel Tracking

][144]

Yodel is a delivery service company in the United Kingdom, and is one of the largest couriers along
with Royal Mail. Read more to find out [how Yodel Tracking works][145].

[

### DPD Tracking

][146]

Dynamic Parcel Distribution or DPD for short is an international express delivery service. DPD has
over 830 terminals in more than 40 countries of the world. Read more to find out [how to track DPD
packages][147]

[

### FedEx SmartPost Tracking

][148]

FedEx SmartPost, which is similar to [UPS SurePost][149], is a hybrid shipping service with which
FedEx will pick up packages from the shipping destination, and then hand the packages off to the
U.S. Postal Service for the final delivery to the end customer. Learn how [FedEx SmartPost
Tracking][150] can help find your package.

[

### Costco

][151]

Costco is a large American warehouse club that sells a wide variety of products in bulk at low
prices, mainly to members who pay an annual fee. It offers groceries, electronics, furniture, and
many other items. For online orders in the U.S., Costco uses various courier services for delivery.

[International Shipping Australia Image]


## The Ultimate Packing Service

Fragile, Large, Awkward or Valuable

Quality packing is non-negotiable for every parcel or freight shipment. Why waste time packing boxes
and storing bulky packaging supplies in your office space, when you can just outsource this hassle
to experts. PACK & SEND can handle your dispatch department and [package your items][49]
sensitively. We pack items using the latest, state-of-the-art packaging techniques. Whether it is
one item or a thousand, we have a solution for all your packaging needs.

[Arts Antiques Image]


## Local & Interstate Delivery Services

Flexible Courier Solutions Across Australia

PACK & SEND offers a full range of delivery options tailored to your needs – from urgent metro
drop-offs to reliable [interstate courier serivces][50]. Our same-day service is ideal for
time-sensitive items, while our [local and point-to-point couriers][51] ensure fast door-to-door
delivery. Need to ship across the country? We make interstate delivery simple, secure, and
cost-effective for businesses and individuals alike.
* **Same-Day Courier Services:** For critical deliveries that can’t wait, our network ensures your
  parcel arrives on the same day.
* **Local Point-to-Point Delivery:** Quick, secure and ideal for metro pickups and drop-offs.
* **Interstate Freight Solutions:** Ship cartons, pallets or oversized goods with full tracking and
  support.

We tailor our courier options to match your timeframe, item size, and destination – whether you're
sending one parcel or coordinating a national distribution.

[Manwboxvan800w]


## More Than 130+ Service Centres Nationwide

Local Experts, Australia-Wide Reach

Wherever you're located in Australia, PACK & SEND is never far away. With over 130 service centres
across the country, we proudly support customers in both major cities and regional towns. From
[Sydney][52] and [Melbourne][53] to [Brisbane][54], [Adelaide][55], [Perth][56] and the [Gold
Coast][57], our national network makes it easy to drop off your parcel, access expert packaging
advice or arrange a convenient pick-up service.

We also operate in many regional locations, providing the same reliable service and shipping
expertise that our metro customers rely on. Every PACK & SEND location is backed by our integrated
systems and customer service promise – so you receive consistent support, no matter where you’re
sending from.

[Storeexterior800w]


## Technology That Puts You in Control

Smart Tools for Stress-Free Shipping

At PACK & SEND, we combine personalised service with powerful technology to make shipping simple and
transparent from start to finish. Our online tools give you complete control – whether you’re
sending a single parcel or managing regular freight.

Use our [instant quote calculator][58] to get an estimate in seconds, or head straight to our
[Online Self-Service portal][59] to book, pay and print your labels 24/7. Every shipment is
supported with full [track and trace][60] visibility, so you always know where your parcel is. For
extra peace of mind, our [Freight Plus Warranty protection][61] gives you coverage against loss or
damage, offering confidence at every step of the journey.

Whether you're a first-time sender or a business with ongoing logistics needs, our digital systems
are designed to save you time and give you total shipping confidence.

[Tech2 800W] [Screenstech800w]


## No Limits to What You Can Send

Any Item. Anywhere. No Hassle.

At PACK & SEND, we specialise in the jobs others say no to. From fragile artworks to oversized
equipment, high-value electronics to bulk freight — we’ve seen it all, and we know how to get it
delivered safely. Our expert team can pack and send items of almost any size, shape or weight to
virtually any location across Australia or around the globe.

Whether you're shipping a surfboard to Spain, industrial parts to regional WA, or a one-of-a-kind
item that needs special care, we find the right solution using air, road or sea freight. With no
limits on complexity or destination, we’re the trusted partner for customers who need more than just
a standard delivery service.

## eCommerce Shipping & Fulfilment

PACK & SEND Live is the perfect shipping solution for eCommerce. Our platform easily integrates with
your website to ship your online orders. We can even store your inventory and fulfil orders for you.

If you are a regular sender of parcels and freight – and your delivery processes aren’t running as
smoothly as they could be, or you believe you are paying more than you should - then it’s time to
request an expert logistics assessment from PACK & SEND.

[Ecommerce Integrated Parcel Sending Image] [Shipping Software For Order Fulfilment Images]


## The International Shipping Experts

Worldwide Shipping to 220+ Countries

We make [international priority shipping][44], [air freight][45] and [sea freight][46]
cost-effective and hassle-free for thousands of happy clients. PACK & SEND's international shipping
services provide a flexible and comprehensive solution for shipping boxes overseas. We also send
pallets and whole containers overseas, including commercial consignments, bulk freight, small
parcels, [excess baggage][47], [overseas relocations][48], documents and airmail.

[International Shipping Australia Image]


## The Ultimate Packing Service

Fragile, Large, Awkward or Valuable

Quality packing is non-negotiable for every parcel or freight shipment. Why waste time packing boxes
and storing bulky packaging supplies in your office space, when you can just outsource this hassle
to experts. PACK & SEND can handle your dispatch department and [package your items][49]
sensitively. We pack items using the latest, state-of-the-art packaging techniques. Whether it is
one item or a thousand, we have a solution for all your packaging needs.

[Arts Antiques Image]


## Local & Interstate Delivery Services

Flexible Courier Solutions Across Australia

PACK & SEND offers a full range of delivery options tailored to your needs – from urgent metro
drop-offs to reliable [interstate courier serivces][50]. Our same-day service is ideal for
time-sensitive items, while our [local and point-to-point couriers][51] ensure fast door-to-door
delivery. Need to ship across the country? We make interstate delivery simple, secure, and
cost-effective for businesses and individuals alike.
* **Same-Day Courier Services:** For critical deliveries that can’t wait, our network ensures your
  parcel arrives on the same day.
* **Local Point-to-Point Delivery:** Quick, secure and ideal for metro pickups and drop-offs.
* **Interstate Freight Solutions:** Ship cartons, pallets or oversized goods with full tracking and
  support.

We tailor our courier options to match your timeframe, item size, and destination – whether you're
sending one parcel or coordinating a national distribution.

[Manwboxvan800w]


## More Than 130+ Service Centres Nationwide

Local Experts, Australia-Wide Reach

Wherever you're located in Australia, PACK & SEND is never far away. With over 130 service centres
across the country, we proudly support customers in both major cities and regional towns. From
[Sydney][52] and [Melbourne][53] to [Brisbane][54], [Adelaide][55], [Perth][56] and the [Gold
Coast][57], our national network makes it easy to drop off your parcel, access expert packaging
advice or arrange a convenient pick-up service.

We also operate in many regional locations, providing the same reliable service and shipping
expertise that our metro customers rely on. Every PACK & SEND location is backed by our integrated
systems and customer service promise – so you receive consistent support, no matter where you’re
sending from.

[Storeexterior800w]


## Technology That Puts You in Control

Smart Tools for Stress-Free Shipping

At PACK & SEND, we combine personalised service with powerful technology to make shipping simple and
transparent from start to finish. Our online tools give you complete control – whether you’re
sending a single parcel or managing regular freight.

Use our [instant quote calculator][58] to get an estimate in seconds, or head straight to our
[Online Self-Service portal][59] to book, pay and print your labels 24/7. Every shipment is
supported with full [track and trace][60] visibility, so you always know where your parcel is. For
extra peace of mind, our [Freight Plus Warranty protection][61] gives you coverage against loss or
damage, offering confidence at every step of the journey.

Whether you're a first-time sender or a business with ongoing logistics needs, our digital systems
are designed to save you time and give you total shipping confidence.

[Tech2 800W] [Screenstech800w]


## No Limits to What You Can Send

Any Item. Anywhere. No Hassle.

At PACK & SEND, we specialise in the jobs others say no to. From fragile artworks to oversized
equipment, high-value electronics to bulk freight — we’ve seen it all, and we know how to get it
delivered safely. Our expert team can pack and send items of almost any size, shape or weight to
virtually any location across Australia or around the globe.

Whether you're shipping a surfboard to Spain, industrial parts to regional WA, or a one-of-a-kind
item that needs special care, we find the right solution using air, road or sea freight. With no
limits on complexity or destination, we’re the trusted partner for customers who need more than just
a standard delivery service.

#### Important Notice

### [ Operational update: supply chain situation in the Middle East ][388]

27 July 2026 - 3 PM (CET)

Transport infrastructure across parts of the Middle East continues to face operational limitations,
impacting global air, ocean and overland logistics.

Rhenus is actively monitoring the situation and coordinating with carriers and partners to support
service continuity wherever possible.

**Current air freight update**

Air freight capacity has recovered strongly, with Gulf carriers restoring more than 80% of
pre-crisis capacity, helping to improve transit times. However, recent security incidents highlight
that routes and schedules remain vulnerable to sudden changes.
* **Middle Eastern Airlines & Air Hubs:** Air freight capacity across the Middle East is returning
  with freighter operations being re-instated and the recovery of most regional hubs.
* **Less constraint APAC-EU Lane and Alternative Hubs:** Less rerouting of cargo is occuring so
  volumes to alternative hubs are also less congested.
* **Surging Surcharges:** While war risk or contingency surcharges have decreased, fluctuations in
  fuel supply and pricing are affecting the Brent Crude Index and even more jet fuel prices
  increasing costs for airlines, as well as road feeder service providers and ground handling
  partners, resulting in the introduction or increase of fuel surcharges.
* **Fuel Supply Disruptions:** The availability of jet fuel in certain regions, specifically
  Southeast Asia, is being monitored closely by airlines. Decisions on airline schedules due to the
  lack of jet fuel availability can cause a further reduction in available capacity and further
  upward pressure on rates in the future.

**Current ocean freight update**

Ongoing security concerns and operational constraints in the Middle East continue to impact global
ocean freight operations.
* **Regional access & routing: **Direct ocean access to parts of the Arabian Gulf remains limited,
  with vessel movements through the Strait of Hormuz and Suez Canal subject to precautionary
  measures. While some direct port calls remain constrained, carriers have resumed limited services
  to selected regional gateway ports. Combined with inland trucking solutions, most destinations
  across the region remain accessible.
* **Operational impact: **Alternative routings, schedule adjustments, and longer transit times
  continue to impact reliability across affected trade lanes.
* **Cost impact: **War risk and security-related surcharges remain in place on selected routes.
  Higher fuel prices are also impacting bunker adjustment factors (BAF) and overall transport costs.
* **Port Congestion & Regional Gateway Status: **Port congestion and operational bottlenecks remain
  present across key regional gateways, contributing to delays

#### Important Notice

### [ Operational update: supply chain situation in the Middle East ][388]

27 July 2026 - 3 PM (CET)

Transport infrastructure across parts of the Middle East continues to face operational limitations,
impacting global air, ocean and overland logistics.

Rhenus is actively monitoring the situation and coordinating with carriers and partners to support
service continuity wherever possible.

**Current air freight update**

Air freight capacity has recovered strongly, with Gulf carriers restoring more than 80% of
pre-crisis capacity, helping to improve transit times. However, recent security incidents highlight
that routes and schedules remain vulnerable to sudden changes.
* **Middle Eastern Airlines & Air Hubs:** Air freight capacity across the Middle East is returning
  with freighter operations being re-instated and the recovery of most regional hubs.
* **Less constraint APAC-EU Lane and Alternative Hubs:** Less rerouting of cargo is occuring so
  volumes to alternative hubs are also less congested.
* **Surging Surcharges:** While war risk or contingency surcharges have decreased, fluctuations in
  fuel supply and pricing are affecting the Brent Crude Index and even more jet fuel prices
  increasing costs for airlines, as well as road feeder service providers and ground handling
  partners, resulting in the introduction or increase of fuel surcharges.
* **Fuel Supply Disruptions:** The availability of jet fuel in certain regions, specifically
  Southeast Asia, is being monitored closely by airlines. Decisions on airline schedules due to the
  lack of jet fuel availability can cause a further reduction in available capacity and further
  upward pressure on rates in the future.

**Current ocean freight update**

Ongoing security concerns and operational constraints in the Middle East continue to impact global
ocean freight operations.
* **Regional access & routing: **Direct ocean access to parts of the Arabian Gulf remains limited,
  with vessel movements through the Strait of Hormuz and Suez Canal subject to precautionary
  measures. While some direct port calls remain constrained, carriers have resumed limited services
  to selected regional gateway ports. Combined with inland trucking solutions, most destinations
  across the region remain accessible.
* **Operational impact: **Alternative routings, schedule adjustments, and longer transit times
  continue to impact reliability across affected trade lanes.
* **Cost impact: **War risk and security-related surcharges remain in place on selected routes.
  Higher fuel prices are also impacting bunker adjustment factors (BAF) and overall transport costs.
* **Port Congestion & Regional Gateway Status: **Port congestion and operational bottlenecks remain
  present across key regional gateways, contributing to delays
